calls.reasoning: Reference class: non-overlapping 10-trading-day windows of the NVDA-minus-AAPL simple return spread with no earnings inside, which has a median near zero (slightly positive over 2023-25 NVDA dominance, reversed over the last 12 months as AAPL grew cap 38% vs NVDA 25%). This is a pure dispersion question: no NVDA or AAPL earnings in Sep 21-Oct 2, GTC DC is Nov 30-Dec 3, and the Oct 1 shutdown risk was removed by the CR signed Sep 2 (funded to Dec 11). Measured daily spread SD ex-earnings is 2.53pp; sqrt(10) scaling gives ~7.9pp, but overlapping 10-day windows show mean reversion, so I use ~6.4pp SD (10-90 width 16.5pp). Direction: bear case for NVDA is the Sep 16 surprise Fed hike to 3.75-4.00% with another signaled, an oil-inflation regime that punishes beta 2.22 vs 1.09, plus six weeks of realized rotation into AAPL (spread ~-8.8pp) with correlation actually negative at -0.19; bull case is NVDA at fwd P/E 18.2 vs AAPL 36.6, 7% off its high with Huang guiding to double chip units, analyst targets 49% above spot vs -3% for AAPL, soft iPhone 18 Pro lead times per BofA with launch-weekend checks landing in the window, and the usual short-horizon reversal favoring the laggard. These cancel, so median ~0 with a hair of positive skew from NVDA's fatter right tail. No market matches the contract; Polymarket's year-end largest-company market is a different instrument and not used as an anchor. Open-bound escapes priced at 3%/3.5% for a macro or AI-capex shock (or an OpenAI-style mega-deal) big enough to move the pair 15pp apart in ten sessions.
